tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the ten supported German student cities and their guide entry points.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List city sections, Germany-wide guides and supported language codes. Optionally choose a supported city.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Fetch a single published guide as Markdown. Use a route returned by list_sections, / for the homepage, and an optional language code. Only known public guide routes are allowed; legal pages are English-only.
